Convert Dataset-Level Metadata to Submission Readiness Evidence

Source: R/dataset_metadata_to_evidence.R
dataset_metadata_to_evidence.Rd

Turns dataset-level metadata - either a metacore object or a plain data.frame - into standardized R4SUB evidence rows describing how completely each dataset (as opposed to each variable) documents itself. Where metacore_to_evidence() reports variable-level documentation presence, this adapter reports the dataset-level counterpart drawn from a metacore object's ds_spec and ds_vars.

dataset_metadata_to_evidence(
  metadata,
  ctx,
  source_name = "metacore",
  source_version = NULL
)

Arguments

metadata

A Metacore object or a data.frame accepted by as_dataset_metadata().

ctx

An r4subcore::r4sub_run_context providing run and study identifiers.

source_name

Character. Label recorded as the evidence source. Default "metacore".

source_version

Character or NULL. Optional version label for the metadata source.

Value

A data.frame conforming to the R4SUB evidence schema, one row per dataset.

Details

One indicator is evaluated per dataset, under the dataset-documentation identifier Q-DEFINE-004. This is distinct from Q-DEFINE-001 (dataset present with a non-empty label), which r4subcore::define_xml_to_evidence() emits, so the two dataset-level checks stay separately identifiable in scoring and explainability:

Q-DEFINE-004

Dataset is documented: it carries a label, a structure description, and at least one key variable.

This is documentation-presence evidence only. The adapter records whether each facet is present; it does not judge whether the documented label, structure, or keys are correct or submission-conformant.

See also

metacore_to_evidence(), adam_to_evidence(), submission_readiness()

Examples

# The CDISC pilot ADaM metacore specification shipped with metacore.
load(metacore::metacore_example("pilot_ADaM.rda"))
ctx <- suppressMessages(r4subcore::r4sub_run_context("CDISCPILOT01", "DEV"))
ev  <- suppressMessages(dataset_metadata_to_evidence(metacore, ctx))
table(ev$result)
#> 
#> pass 
#>    5
